newsitem.title: BRAZIL: GM to announce new Brazil car factory - paper.
newsitem.headline: GM to announce new Brazil car factory - paper.

text.p: General Motors Corp of the U.S. (GM) should announce it is to build its third car factory in Brazil after municipal elections, for which the first round voting is to take place October 3, local newspaper Jornal do Brasil said Saturday.
The factory would involve an investment of around $600 million to produce a compact car on the same lines as the Ka recently announced by Ford, the newspaper added.

The facility would almost certainly be located either in the states of Minas Gerais or Santa Catarina and the company has already contacted various Brazilian banks and the government concerning the operation.
GM's decision to build the factory stems from the fact compact cars represent 60 percent of the Brazilian market, Jornal do Brasil said.
The company's Corsa has already proved to be a success in Brazil but GM has preferred to increase production of this line in Argentina.

If confirmed, GM would join a long list of international car manufacturers including Volkswagen, Toyota, Honda, Ford, Renault and Audi which have announced new investments since President Fernando Henrique Cardoso took office, the paper said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
